दृढ १

DṚḌHA I . (DṚḌHAVARMAN). One of the hundred sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra. Bhīmasena killed him in the great war. (droṇa parva, Chapter 137).

दृढ २

DṚḌHA II . (dṛḍhakṣatra). One of the hundred sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra. Bhīmasena killed him. (droṇa Parva, Chapter 157).

दृढधन्वा

DṚḌHADHANVĀ . A King of the pūru dynasty. He was present on the occasion of Pāñcālī's svayaṁvara. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 105. Verse 15).

दृढहस्त

DṚḌHAHASTA . One of the hundred sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 67, Verse 102).

दृढक्षत्र

DṚḌHAKṢATRA . See dṛḍha II.

दृढनेमि

DṚḌHANEMI . A King of the pūru dynasty. He was the son of Satyahṛdi and father of supārśva. (bhāgavata, Daśama skandha).

दृढरथ १

DṚḌHARATHA I . (dṛḍharathāśraya). One of the 100 sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra killed in the great war by bhīma. (droṇa parva, Chapter 157).

दृढरथ २

DṚḌHARATHA II . One of the kings, who should be remembered both at dawn and before sun-set. (anuśāsana parva, Chapter 165, Verse 52).

दृढरथाश्रय

DṚḌHARATHĀŚRAYA . See dṛḍharatha I.

दृढसन्ध

DṚḌHASANDHA . (śatruñjaya). One of the 100 sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra. He was killed in the great war by bhīma. (droṇa parva Chapter 137, Verse 20).

दृढसेन

DṚḌHASENA . A King of the yayāti dynasty. He fought in the great war on the side of the pāṇḍavas and was killed by droṇa. (droṇa parva, Chapter 21, Verse 52).

दृढाश्व

DṚḌHĀŚVA . A famous king of the ikṣvāku dynasty. He was the son of Kuvalayāśva who had 21,000 sons. All those sons but three were killed in the fight with an asura called dhundhu. The three sons who survived the killing were dṛḍhāśva, kapilāśva and candrāśva. (Vana Parva, Chapter 204).

दृढस्यु

DṚḌHASYU . A son born to agastya maharṣi by lopāmudrā. He was born only after remaining in the mother's womb for seven years. He was a very great scholar and tapasvī. He began studying the Vedas from the very time of his birth. He is called idhmavāha also. (See idhmavāha).

दृढवर्मा १

DṚḌHAVARMĀ I . See dṛḍha I.

दृढवर्मा २

DṚḌHAVARMĀ II . A King. Kadalīgarbhā was the name of his wife. (See under Kadalīgarbhā).

दृढव्य

DṚḌHAVYA . A maharṣi. He was one of the seven Ṛtviks of Dharamarāja. Unmucu, Pramucu, ātreya, dṛḍhavya, ūrdhvabāhu, Tṛṇasoma and aṅgiras were the seven Ṛtviks. (anuśāsana parva, Chapter 150, Verse 34).

दृढव्रत

DṚḌHAVRATA . A brahmarṣi who lived in South india. (śānti Parva, Chapter 208, Verse 28).

दृढायु १

DṚḌHĀYU I . Son born to King purūravas by urvaśī. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 75, Verse 25).

दृढायु २

DṚḌHĀYU II . A King who lived in North india during the time of the great war. (Udyoga Parva, Chapter 4, Verse 23).

दृढायु ३

DṚḌHĀYU III . A brahmarṣi of South india. He is known as dṛḍhavya and dṛḍhavrata also (Anuśāsana Parva, Chapter 65, Verse 40).

दृढायुध

DṚḌHĀYUDHA . (citrāyudha). One of the 100 sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra killed in the great war. (droṇa Parva, Chapter 136, Verse 20).

दृढेयु

DṚḌHEYU . A maharṣi who lived in the western part of india. (anuśāsana parva, Chapter 150, Verse 36).

दृढेष्टधी

DṚḌHEṢṬADHĪ . A King in ancient india. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 1, Verse 238).
